package dailyassignments;

public class InvertedRightAngleTriangle {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		/*
		 * 1)Inverted Right-Angled Triangle
			For n = 5:
			*****
			****
			***
			**
			*

		 */

		
		//Rows
				for(int i=5;i>=1;i--)
				{
										
					//stars
					for(int j=1;j<=i;j++)
					{
				
						System.out.print("*");
					}
					System.out.println("");
				}
				
				
				/*
				 * 2)Increasing Number Triangle
					For n = 5:
					1
					12
					123
					1234
					12345
				 */
				
				System.out.println();
				
				
				//number of rows
				for(int i=1;i<=5;i++)
				{
					int num=1;
										
					//numbers
					for(int j=1;j<=i;j++)
					{
				
						System.out.print(num);
						num++;
					}
				
					System.out.println(" ");
				}
				
				
				/*
				 * 3)Repeated Number Triangle
					1
					22
					333
					4444
					55555
				 */
				
				System.out.println("");
				
				int num=1;
				//number of rows
				for(int i=1;i<=5;i++)
				{
														
					//numbers
					for(int j=1;j<=i;j++)
					{
				
						System.out.print(num);
						
					}
					num++;
					System.out.println(" ");
				}
	}

}
